'''Alysssa Maggrit''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|girl]] who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on<ref name="WC" /> the floating [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="Date" /> [[Tolea Biqua]]<ref name="WC" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] around [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> By the age of twelve, Maggrit ran numbers for her [[Alysssa Maggrit's uncle|uncle's]] illegal activity on Tolea Biqua<ref name="WC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> Maggrit's cover was blown when the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] known as [[wampa1]] revealed her name on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], mistakenly believing her to be the slicer [[alyssa]]roxu. The true alyssaroxu speculated that wampa1's actions would lead Maggrit's uncle to track down and harm the slicer.<ref name="WC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alysssa Maggrit was first mentioned in "[[Destabilization (article)|Destabilization]]," an article written by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] as a tie in to the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] roleplaying campaign. The article was published on the [[Wizards of the Coast]] website on [[January 5]], [[2004]].<ref name="WC" />
